say:1:1433102001:1.text: Every time I pass through here, I remember my friend, Turo.
say:1:1433102001:1.source_cn: 每次走到这，我都会想起我的朋友杜拉。
say:1:1433102001:1.male: Every time I pass through here, I remember my friend, Turo.
say:1:1433102001:1.female: Every time I pass through here, I remember my friend, Turo.

say:3:1433102002:1.text: When we were servants, she'd sneak time to read while cleaning the master's study.
say:3:1433102002:1.source_cn: 以前当仆从的时候，她借着给主人打扫书房的机会，读了好多...
say:3:1433102002:1.male: When we were servants, she'd sneak time to read while cleaning the master's study.
say:3:1433102002:1.female: When we were servants, she'd sneak time to read while cleaning the master's study.

say:4:1433102003:1.text: She once told me a book mentioned something called the "starry sky"—something that looked a lot like this lake.
say:4:1433102003:1.source_cn: 她跟我说，书里写着，地表上曾经有叫“星空”的东西，和这...
say:4:1433102003:1.male: She once told me a book mentioned something called the "starry sky"—something that looked a lot like this lake.
say:4:1433102003:1.female: She once told me a book mentioned something called the "starry sky"—something that looked a lot like this lake.

say:5:1433102004:1.text: But stars weren't in the water. They were above people's heads. And the departed... they become stars, watching over those who still miss them.
say:5:1433102004:1.source_cn: 但星空不在水中，而是在人们的头顶。离去的人都会化作星星...
say:5:1433102004:1.male: But stars weren't in the water. They were above people's heads. And the departed... they become stars, watching over those who still miss them.
say:5:1433102004:1.female: But stars weren't in the water. They were above people's heads. And the departed... they become stars, watching over those who still miss them.

say:7:1433102005:1.text: Then she packed up and left to find the stars. I haven't seen her since.
say:7:1433102005:1.source_cn: 后来啊，她真的背上行囊去找星星了，自那以后，我再也没有...
say:7:1433102005:1.male: Then she packed up and left to find the stars. I haven't seen her since.
say:7:1433102005:1.female: Then she packed up and left to find the stars. I haven't seen her since.

say:8:1433102006:1.text: I never had her courage. So every time I miss her, I come here... and look for the sky she spoke of.
say:8:1433102006:1.source_cn: 我没有她那样的勇气，所以，每次想她的时候，我都会到这里...
say:8:1433102006:1.male: I never had her courage. So every time I miss her, I come here... and look for the sky she spoke of.
say:8:1433102006:1.female: I never had her courage. So every time I miss her, I come here... and look for the sky she spoke of.

say:9:1433102007:1.text: Look, the starry sky is truly beautiful.
say:9:1433102007:1.male: Look, the starry sky is truly beautiful.
say:9:1433102007:1.female: Look, the starry sky is truly beautiful.
